DESIGN THESIS
A governed inspection workspace with the video stage treated as one evidence source beside agenda, checklist and capture—not the whole product.
Why this way: Video-call clones lose inspection structure; a regulatory session needs identity, evidence requests, notes, progress and fallback.
Signature differentiator: Evidence request rail timestamps what the inspector asked to see, what was shown, what was captured and whether it was sufficient.
Outlier/hard case: Video provider pending, weak connection, participant drop, insufficient evidence and fallback to physical inspection.
